role: Declares four fact namespaces: HRVLiveNamespace (hrv.live.* from LiveHRVBroker snapshot), TagsNamespace (tags.* over archive index tags/recovery scores), HRRNamespace (hrr.* averages/trend from archived workouts' HRR samples) and CompositesNamespace (user.profile.snapshot, training.load.snapshot, walks.summary, recovery.today.full, recovery.week.summary).
types: HRVLiveNamespace: struct (FactNamespaceResolver) — live HRV recording state
state: HRVLiveNamespace.namespace = 'hrv' (the head token of every hrv.live.* key, so the registry's primary dispatch reaches it)
toplevel: Struct conformances; registered in AppFactResolverFactory (HRVLive/HRR/Tags in registerHealthNamespaces, Composites last in build).

units.does: Returns LiveHRVBroker.currentSnapshot() — the provider closure RRCollector registered, or nil when no HRV recording is active.
calls: closure:LiveHRVBroker.provider installed by the RRCollector owner via registerProvider

Builds the full live-HRV record {phase, phase_description, is_collecting, beat_count, snapshot_at, elapsed_sec?, session_started_at?, last_error?} or missing when no snapshot.
Returns the 9 hrv.live entries.
